balls.text: full and wide, misses a heave to a 142 kph delivery. They decide not to run a bye as Shahrukh wants Brar to review this for a possible wide but on the live shot it looked like it passed well within the wide guidelines outside off stump and will end as a dot to finish the innings.
slower ball at 114 kph lands full on middle, Brar isn't fooled one bit as he clears the front leg and slaughters this high and deep landing 90 meters back in the 20th row.
144 kph yorker on off, jammed out into the covers for one.
length ball on sixth stump at 137 kph, Shahrukh clears the front leg trying to heave over midwicket and slices a thick edge over short third to the rope.
length ball on eighth stump, flays a cut behind point that speeds to the rope.
full on fourth stump, windup and heave a mile high over long-on by Shahrukh clears the rope by 20 yards.
goes for yorker on fourth stump but it comes in as a shin high full toss that is pumped over mid-off bouncing away to the rope.
length ball speared way down the leg side this time, wide called.
yorker lands outside leg stump after Brar charges down the wicket missing a heave before the ball passes between him and the stumps.
wide yorker on eighth stump, sliced out behind point for one.
127 kph delivery lands short on the stumps, pulls this fiercely through square leg to the rope.
short on the legs, short arm jab pull flutters wide of short fine leg for one.
fullish length ball on middle stump, goes to drive down the ground after clearing the front leg and slices a thick edge past short third to the rope.
another googly lands short and wide, this time Brar toe slaps it to long-off for one.
googly lands short and wide and spins a long way across an attempted cut.
good length ball on the legs, flicked through midwicket for one.
googly spins well down the leg side, wide called.
good length ball wide outside off, slapped through cover for one.

fuller and wider on sixth stump, Curran goes to slog sweep this and top edges this swirling over midwicket in the ring. Gurbaz runs out from behind the stumps and calls off Suyash before taking this tumbling forward. There was no fielder in the ring on the leg side so one of the two had to go for it.
googly pitches outside leg and spins across a forward prod on off stump.
full on the stumps, driven back to the bowler who fields diving to his right in front of the non-striker.
bullseye! Fullish length on fourth stump and continues on with the angle, Rishi goes for a slog for midwicket and misses everything as off stump is knocked back halfway up.
length ball on the wide guideline, reaches out a long way to drag a pull along the ground through square leg for two.
short and wide on eighth stump, slices a cut straight to short third on the ring for none.
full on sixth stump, driven firmly to extra cover for none.
short on the stumps, pulled flat over square leg and thuds into the base of the ad boards.
good length ball on fourth stump, sliced behind point for one.
full on off, chipped gently through vacant midwicket and this time they do run two.
back of a length on the stumps, heaved to wide long-on for a long single.
full and wide, driven hard but straight to extra cover for none.
full on off, chipped to long-on for one.
good length ball on fourth stump, guided with an open face past the keeper to short third for one.
full on fifth stump, punched to long-off for one.
not wasting any time after coming to the middle! First ball in the slog on fourth stump, why not have a heave and Rishi connects sending this sailing wide of deep midwicket one bounce over the rope.

fullish length ball on middle, Shikhar charges and miscues a heave down the ground coming off the bat nearer the toe and a chance floats gently to long-on where a chest height catch is taken by Vaibhav Arora 10 yards inside the rope.
good length ball on middle, awkward flat-footed flick by Shikhar results in an inside edge just past leg stump through fine leg for two.
full outside leg, sweeps this flat to short fine leg for none.
good length ball on the legs, Shikhar charges and punches back to Rana.
good length ball on sixth stump, punched to backward point for none.
good length ball punched down the ground to long-off for one.

full on middle, Shikhar premeditates a reverse sweep but picks out backward point on the ring for none. Arora charged forward trying to create a catching chance with the ball floating gently toward him but it winds up short-hopping him.
full on fifth stump, Shikhar shuffles outside off to get in line and sweeps this flat over deep square leg for six to bring up a 41-ball half-century.  It's his third IPL fifty in 2023.
good length into the legs, flicked to deep midwicket for one.
full on fifth stump, tapped into the covers for none.
full on fifth stump, driven to long-off for one.
back of a length on middle, Shikhar goes back to tap into vacant midwicket looking for two but he's tapped it too hard so they settle for one with deep midwicket charging in from the rope to collect.
knee high full toss on middle, punched along the ground to long-on for one.
good length ball on sixth stump, Jitesh tries to run this with an open face through third man but gets a very thin edge held onto by Gurbaz behind the stumps.
short on off, miscues a pull that floats short of deep midwicket for one.
full and tailing down leg, Shikhar is late on a sweep and wide is called.
good length ball breaks in sharply toward middle, Shikhar jams this out adjusting his cut shot late to defend.
good length on sixth stump, goes back to punch and a thick edge bounces to short third for none.
good length ball skims just past the wide guideline past a cut shot as well, wide called.
good length ball on sixth stump, tapped into cover for one.
quicker ball on a good length on sixth stump, defended to cover.
full on seventh stump, Shikhar goes for the orthodox sweep this time and sends it flat over square leg, one bounce over the rope.
full on middle, reverse sweeps this high and deep over backward point, one bounce over the rope.
good length ball on the stumps, heaves this to deep midwicket for one.
googly lands on a fullish length on fifth stump and spins across past a forward prod.
Shikhar premeditates another reverse sweep and Suyash sends down a shin high full toss on sixth stump that is swatted over backward square leg to the rope.
good length on middle, flicked to long-on for one.
googly spins in on a good length from off stump past leg stump following Jitesh backing away and he is cramped trying to play a pull that slides past the edge.
full and spinning into middle and leg, Jitesh clears the front leg and slogs this high over midwicket just clearing the rope.
full on middle, goes to flick through mid-on but a leading edge floats just short of the bowler lunging forward.
back of a length on fourth stump, punched to long-off for one.
good length ball on seventh stump, Shikhar premeditates a reverse and swats this to short third for one.
good length ball on seventh stump, guides this to backward point for none.
length ball on eighth stump, charges this and swats a bottom edge into the ground.
good length ball on the stumps, flicked into midwicket for one.
full outside leg stump, goes to sweep and misses. Big appeal for caught behind as there's a noise with the ball appearing to flick the pads. Not out given. KKR go for a review.
full on the legs, flicked into midwicket for one.

tries to zip in a quicker ball but grips it too tightly and results in a drag down at 98 kph landing very short on sixth stump, Jitesh rocks back and slams a pull flat over wide long-on landing 79 meters away.
quicker and flatter landing short on the wide guideline, cuts this to deep point for one.
full on fifth stump, Shikhar reverse sweeps this straight to short third for none.
googly lands full and very wide spinning past a drive but stays inside the guideline for a dot.
full on fifth stump, goes to heave this down the ground and a thick inside edge goes into the leg side for one.
back of a length on sixth stump, opens the face and runs this past the diving effort of the man at short third and goes to the rope.
good length ball on off, goes back to defend to cover.
full on sixth stump, goes to sweep and drags a bottom edge into his pads.
back of a length on the stumps, goes back to punch to long-on for one.
back of a length on fifth stump, prods this into the covers for none.
short on the stumps, goes back to flick through midwicket for one.
back of a length on off, punched to extra cover for none.
short on fourth stump, pulled through midwicket for one.
full on seventh stump, Shikhar goes to drive and it spins back in as a legbreak past the drive and goes through the legs of Gurbaz behind the stumps for four byes.
googly on a good length on off stump, Shikhar prods forward inside the line as it spins away past the outside edge.
good length ball skids across sixth stump past a cut shot for none.
back of a length on off, goes back to cross bat this through mid-on for one.
full on fifth stump, sweeps this powerfully behind square leg to the rope.
short on the wide guideline, cuts this straight to backward point for none.
good length ball spinning into middle and leg, goes back and shovels this awkwardly over mid-on for one.

Chakaravarthy sends down a leg break that fools Livingstone on a good length expecting a googly misreading this out of the hand and defends down the wrong line. Ball strikes him on the pads in front of off stump, huge lbw shout upheld. Livingstone reviews this. Main doubt was height. But he was clearly struck in line with the stumps. Glitch on ball-tracking. It shows the ball hitting him in line but the projection stops and the drama builds.... Finally the projection is showing the ball clipping the bails on umpire's call. The decision stays out.
full on sixth stump, punched to wide mid-off for one.
good length ball on off flicked through midwicket for one.

135 kph bouncer on off, top edges a pull that swirls high over fine leg and teases the fielder running back from the edge of the circle all the way to the rope as a tumbling slap-back effort is in vain.
back of a length on sixth stump, guided behind point to deep third for one.
low full toss on eighth stump, slices a drive through cover to the rope.
knee high full toss on middle stump at 138 kph, flicked effortlessly over midwicket to the rope. Sire goes off again. No ball and free hit to come for Livingstone.
full in the slot hugging the wide guideline, Livingstone shuffles across and drives in the air over wide mid-off to the rope.
length ball angled across eighth stump at 133 kph, goes to heave and misses.
full on off at 135 kph, heaves across the line and an inside edge goes behind square leg for one.
short ball on eighth stump, Livingstone tries to swat this and misses. Deemed legal on height.
back of a length on sixth stump, guides this behind point for a single to deep third. Siren goes off with the foot landing marginally across the line. No ball and free hit to come.
back of a length on the stumps at 142 kph, goes back to defend.
fullish length ball angled across sixth stump at 145 kph, goes to drive and a thin edge is held comfortable at chest height by Gurbaz shuffling to his left to send the home fans into a frenzy.
hat-trick of leg byes to begin the over. Back of a length on the hips, goes to flick and misses off the hips trickling behind square leg for another extra.
back of a length angled into the body from over the wicket, goes to flick and misses off the pads. Dribbles into cover for an extra.
back of a length on the legs, flicked into the leg side for a casual single. Direct hit comes into the stumps at the striker's end but Rajapaksa was comfortably in.
good length ball angled into fourth stump, huge inside edge into the pads going back to defend. Big lbw shout denied. But everyone keeps moving between overs without a review.
good length ball angled in on fifth stump before seaming away again, this time Shikhar opens the face to guide this behind point for one.
gem! Angles this in back of a length at 131 kph on fourth stump before it seams away to beat a poke by Shikhar.
back of a length on sixth stump, Shikhar charges and slashes this barely clearing the fielder at short third on the ring before going to the rope.
133 kph back of a length on middle, defended.
fullish length just inside the wide guideline, left alone.

circus catch behind the stumps! Prabhsimran charges a length ball on middle and tries to swat this over the leg side but it climbs on him a touch and he gets a thin top edge. The ball redirects high to the right of Gurbaz behind the stumps. He reaches up to his right above head height and parries it in the air initially before shuffling a few more steps backward to his right to lunge and collect it on the second attempt before the ball can hit the turf.

good length ball swinging in toward middle at 139 kph, Prabhsimran prods forward and there are two noises with the ball brushing onto the pads. Massive lbw shout is denied. Hard to tell if it was an inside edge onto the pads or front pad onto back pad. It was high as well.
144 kph good length ball on the stumps, flicked through midwicket for one.
length ball angled across seventh stump at 141 kph, Shikhar flays this high over backward point and it backspins away to the rope.
good length ball on middle, goes back to defend and inside edges this into the ground backspinning just over the stumps.
full and very wide, driven firmly along the ground through cover and skids away to the rope.
back of a length on seventh stump this time swinging away at 131 kph, Prabhsimran cuts this firmly behind point to the rope.
very full inswinger on off stump at 136 kph, whipped away over midwicket to the rope.
back of a length on sixth stump seaming in again but not as sharply at 132 kph, defended to cover.
sharp insuring again on a good length on off stump at 134 kph, defended back down the pitch.
another sharp inswinger this time on a fuller length on the legs, Prabhsimran just flicks this through backward square leg to the rope.
seaming in very sharply on a good length almost from the wide guideline darting in on fifth stump, Prabhsimran goes to cut and bottom edges this into the ground.

Rinku to the rescue! Carbon copy of the thigh high full toss that followed him outside leg earlier in the over. On that occasion, Arshdeep escaped with just a single. But this time Rinku middles the ball smashing it cleanly in the gap between deep fine leg and deep backward square leg screeching one bounce over the rope to win it for KKR!

full and wide yorker, Russell misses trying to jam this out through point. Rinku alertly tries to steal a bye and gets a great start. Russell is very late leaving his ground though and the relay from the keeper to Arshdeep results in Arshdeep gently tossing the ball into the stumps from five yards away with Russell a few feet short.
139 kph delivery full and wide on the guideline outside off, Russell slices a drive high and wide of the cover sweeper for two.

thigh high full toss follows Rinku backing away from leg stump, could have easily gone for six to end the match on most days... but Rinku scuffs this flat into the ground to deep backward square leg for just a single.
full and wide at 135 kph, Russell slices a drive to deep third for one.
bouncer on off, ducked under by Russell.

alligator arms by Livingstone out at cover sweeper! Another slower bouncer on middle. It's slapped high in the air toward the off side boundary. Livingstone had a good three seconds of time to charge in off the rope but halts his charge 10 yards in off the rope and lets it bounce five yards in front of him. If it was a World Cup or tourney final, he'd have put in a dive for sure.

slower bouncer on fifth stump, this time Russell is not fooled! Russell clears the front leg initially before adjusting to crank this the other way over backward point and it screams 66 meters landing in between the LCD ad boards and the fencing in front of the first row of fans.

bouncer on fourth stump, Russell backs away from leg stump before adjusting to try to uppercut this over third and misses. Russell wants a wide called from square leg but none comes and he opts not to review it.

another half-volley outside leg at 137 kph, another six sails even deeper over midwicket into the crowd. Curran continues to get the line and length wrong and Russell punishes him 83 meters back into the 12th row.
133 kph half-volley lands full outside leg stump, Russell whips this with plenty of forearm strength high over midwicket sailing into the first row of the stands.
full and wide yorker on eighth stump, jammed out to wide long-off for one.
Arshdeep follows Rinku backing away from leg stump almost off the pitch and lands a 138 kph yorker that is flicked out to deep square leg for one.
bouncer on leg stump at 135 kph, Rinku backs away and can't get bat on this trying to uppercut over the keeper.
Rinku backs away from leg stump, Arshdeep follows him with a yorker landing a foot outside leg and Rinku gets a thin inside edge past the keeper to the fine leg rope.
full and wide on the guideline, slashes this to deep third fielded on a bounce for one.
attempted yorker lands as a half-volley outside leg stump at 141 kph, Russell flicks this past the keeper with ease to the fine leg rope.
full and wide yorker hugging the guideline, Russell misses a wild heave and the ball is deemed legal.
full and wide yorker on seventh stump, Rinku jams this out behind point for two.
yorker lands perfectly on middle and leg, jammed out to long-on for one.
slower short ball on sixth stump, pulled flat to deep midwicket for one.
ka-boom! Full on middle and leg, Rinku steps forward and smashes this over deep square leg to send the crowd into a frenzy. VIPs are blowing kisses from the owner's box out to Rinku.
slower ball lands full and wide, Russell drags a pull through midwicket along the ground for one.
full on leg stump, Russell heaves this flat through wide midwicket beating the boundary rider.
short and wide, carves a cut to the sweeper for one.
short again and wide outside off, slapped through wide cover for two.
short and hugging the wide guideline, goes to pull and misses.
half-tracker lands almost off the pitch outside off, wide called.
back of a length on fifth stump, flicked through deep midwicket for one.

good length ball outside leg stump, Rana hops around to reverse swat this high and deep over wide cover. He gets under this far more than intended and it hangs in the air long enough for Livingstone to cover 30 yards running across to his right from long-off and take a superb sliding catch on his knees going feet first to latch on in the breadbasket at thigh height.

full on middle, flicks through wide midwicket for two to bring up a 37-ball half-century to the captain. Polite applause from the home fans. Not exactly raucous cheers as they can sense this match is tilting toward Punjab.
127 kph slower bouncer on the body, Russell turtles his head while playing a pull shot and a thin top edge swirls just wide of the keeper to the fine leg rope.
short ball on fifth stump, Russell hops on his toes to cut and misses.
full on fourth stump, smokes a drive straight to long-off for one.
full on sixth stump, driven firmly to extra cover for none.
short and wide on eighth stump, slapped to extra cover for none.
good length ball on the legs, flicked to deep midwicket for one.
short and spinning outside the wide guideline, bottom edges a cut past the keeper for one.
short on seventh stump, cuts this straight to backward point for none.

googly lands on a fullish length on middle and spins away from Iyer's charge down the track. He shovels this in the air off the toe and a chance floats to long-off where Livingstone holds onto a basic chance eight yards in from the rope.
full on middle, sweeps this behind square leg for one.
googly lands short on fifth stump and spins away to create more room for a cut that is middled between cover and extra cover to the rope. 50 partnership comes up off 37 balls.
full on the legs, sweeps this to backward square leg for one.

full and wide, slices a drive wide of the cover sweeper Ellis who slides across to keep this to two runs. However, Ellis' back foot stepped on the rope as he was getting onto his feet so the third umpire has ruled it a four.
132 kph delivery lands full on seventh stump, driven to extra cover for none.
full and wide, miscues a drive off the lower end of the bat dribbling into cover for one.
knee high full toss on sixth stump, punched along the ground to deep cover for one.
almost identical sequence to the previous delivery, short ball outside the wide guideline, but Nitish had shuffled across and leaves it be. This time called a wide.

length ball hugs the wide guideline, Nitish shuffles across and leaves it alone. It was clearly outside the wide guideline but the umpire felt Nitish had moved across his stumps far enough to be within reach.
full on sixth stump, goes to drive and gets a thick edge that splits the keeper and short third to the rope.
good length ball on the legs, flicked to deep midwicket for one.
quicker ball lands short outside leg, goes back to flick to midwicket and a leading edge goes through extra cover for one.
good length ball on the legs, flicked into deep midwicket for one.
good length ball outside leg, flicked to deep midwicket for two.
floated full on leg stump, Iyer charges and miscues a flick down the ground for one.
good length ball on sixth stump, guides this behind point for none.
full on fifth stump, driven to long-on for one.
another flighted delivery on a good length on middle, goes back to flick through midwicket for one.
Livingstone gives this more air by floating it full and wide, Rana goes for a booming drive and misses.

overcorrection landing short on fourth stump, Rana rocks back and smokes a pull flat over wide long-on thudding into the fencing in front of the first row of seats as some photographers duck for cover.
Pure class! Full on fifth stump, Rana shuffles down the track backing away from leg and drives elegantly inside out over extra cover, two bounces over the rope.
full on the stumps, Rana pumps this flat over the umpire splitting long-on and long-off to the rope.
back of a length on the stumps, punched to long-on for one.
full on the legs, sweeps this to backward square leg for none again.
googly lands on a fullish length on middle and fools Rana playing back flicking this back toward Chahar but lands just short.
full on the legs, sweeps this to backward square leg for none.
good length ball on the legs, flicked to deep square leg for one.
good length ball on the stumps, flicked through midwicket for one.
back of a length on fifth stump, punches this to the cover sweeper for one.
full on fourth stump, punched to deep cover for one.
back of a length on fifth stump, cuts this to deep point for one.
back of a length on off, punched to deep cover for one.
back of a length on the legs, flicked to deep midwicket for one.
133 kph full outside off, driven through cover to the sweeper for one.
full on eighth stump, miscues a drive off an inside edge into his feet.
full on off stump, driven along the ground to long-off for one.
full on seventh stump, flicked to wide long-on for one.
full and wide on seventh stump, slices this high over cover for one.

full on leg stump, sweeps this but doesn't control the shot and it floats toward deep midwicket where Shahrukh Khan comes in eight yards off the rope to take a simple chest height catch. Brar raises his finger aloft in celebration.
full and wide, drives along the ground to the cover sweeper for one.
overcorrection from Livingstone now landing this short and wide outside off, sits up for Roy to punch authoritatively through cover past the diving ring fielder to the rope.
full toss at knee height two feet outside leg stump, goes to sweep this and scoops it very high and fine with the angle over fine leg.
back of a length on the legs, flicked to deep midwicket for one.
back of a length on middle, backs away to cut to deep point for one.
full outside leg stump, premeditates a reverse sweep and it comes off the arm before landing wide of the keeper for none.
full and wide, driven through cover for one.
short on fifth stump, goes back to pull this high over midwicket to the rope.
back of a length outside leg, flicked to deep backward square leg and beats the boundary rider to the rope.
length ball on fifth stump, slices this behind point for none.
good length ball on fifth stump, punched into the off side for one.
126 kph length ball on fifth stump, Rana rocks back and smashes a pull over wide long-on, one bounce over the rope.
good length ball on the stumps, defended to midwicket.
139 kph delivery full on the stumps, flicked through midwicket for one.
back of a length on fourth stump, sliced to backward point for none.

full and straight again with back of the hand slower ball landing on middle beating a flick from Gurbaz, huge lbw shout this time is upheld as Ellis chases after the ball in short cover attempting to deny a leg bye just in case. Gurbaz reviews this but it looks stone dead and he already starts wandering off before the replays are done.  Three reds light up on ball-tracking. Review lost.
back of a length on fifth stump, shuffles across to flick into midwicket for one.
full and straight on middle and leg stump, shuffle across to flick misses. Looked very straight and the keeper goes wild with an appeal but no lbw shout whatsoever from Ellis and a leg bye is taken.
back of a length on middle, Gurbaz goes across to flick through midwicket and a leading edge goes back toward Ellis but falls well short.
short and wide on the wide guideline, reaches out and toe slaps this just wide of extra cover on the ring and bounces away to the rope.
short and wide, slapped to mid-off along the ground for none.
low full toss on fifth stump, spoons this tamely short of mid-off for none.
length ball on seventh stump, slashes this out to deep point for one.
short on the stumps, shuffles across to hook and misses. Wide called on height.
full on fifth stump, shuffles across again and drives firmly back past Roy to the mid-off rope.
length ball on off stump, Gurbaz shuffles across and flicks this high and deep over fine leg thudding into the fifth row of seats.
full on off, jammed out to long-on for one.
125 kph delivery back of a length on sixth stump, slapped to extra cover and they scamper a tight single.
good length ball on the legs, Roy flicks this in the air just wide of Arshdeep's outstretched left hand lunging at short fine leg on the ring and goes to the rope.
back of a length on fifth stump, another cross bat swipe misses.
back of a length on fourth stump, Roy goes for another heave across the line and misses.
short on the stumps, Roy does a mini shuffle forward and pulls this through wide midwicket before it bounces away to the rope.
fullish length ball on sixth stump, Gurbaz shuffles across and whips this in the air past Arshdeep's outstretched right hand but it lands just short of mid-on for none.
gem! Fullish length at 134 kph angled on middle stump before seaming away past a back foot defensive prod.
back of a length on fourth stump, goes to cut and is cramped for room producing a bottom edge past leg stump for one to short fine leg.
length ball on sixth stump, goes for another slap and misses again.
length ball angled across eighth stump, goes to drive on the up and is beaten.
full and swinging into middle and leg, flicked just wide of short midwicket and bounces away to the rope.
full on sixth stump, goes to heave to midwicket and bottom edges this through the leg side for one.
full on fifth stump at 136 kph, defended into the off side for none.
back of a length on fifth stump, Gurbaz charges and slaps this over midwicket, not timed well and trickles short of the rope for three.
short ball on sixth stump at 133 kph, slashes at this and misses. Fumble behind the stumps by the keeper as the ball swerved back late toward the leg side.
full on sixth stump, pushed to extra cover for none.
back of a length on the stumps at 130 kph, flicked into midwicket for one.
